# Vendored MapLibre GL JS 5.6.1

Unmodified pinned MapLibre GL JS distribution, licensed under the accompanying BSD-3-Clause license (and included third-party notices). Downloaded from the npm package CDN on 2026-11-17; no runtime CDN dependency. The CSP build loads the local dedicated worker with `setWorkerUrl`, requiring only `worker-src self`.

MapLibre is loaded only when a gate map is opened. The only hosted basemap is OpenFreeMap Liberty: `https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty`. Style, sprites, glyphs, TileJSON and tiles use `tiles.openfreemap.org`; attribution remains visible beneath the map. No reverse geocoding or paid map API is used. Physical iPhone/Safari and affected ISP acceptance must be recorded separately; desktop/headless testing does not satisfy it.
